# TripFlow

TripFlow is a travel-planning progressive web app (PWA) with AI-generated
itineraries, route optimization, real-time collaboration, interactive maps,
offline access and PDF export. Built by Diego Sánchez (CuB1z) as a Software
Engineering Bachelor's Thesis at Universidad Rey Juan Carlos.

## Navigation

- [Home](https://tripflow.cub1z.es/): landing page with features and install guide.
- [Login](https://tripflow.cub1z.es/login): sign in to an existing account.
- [Sign up](https://tripflow.cub1z.es/signup): create a new account.
- [Help](https://tripflow.cub1z.es/help): usage guide and FAQ.
- [Privacy](https://tripflow.cub1z.es/privacy): privacy policy.
